Ubuntu fixes.

The close button quits the app. There is an icon in the dock and in the tray, and a Quit button in the window.

Start when I sign in writes a startup entry in your account. If that folder is not writable, the message names the file.

If the pump says permission denied, unplug the cooler and plug it back in.

- strix-lc-screen-windows-x86_64.zip. Unzip it and run strix-lc-screen.exe. Keep ffmpeg.exe in that folder.
- strix-lc-screen-linux-x86_64.tar.gz. The program, ffmpeg, and a udev rule.
- strix-lc-screen_0.1.2_amd64.deb for Debian and Ubuntu.
